items.tldr: OpenAI releases GPT-5 turbo — inference cost down 60%, but benchmark gains only 3%. Diminishing returns are here.
items.tldr_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-5 turbo，推理成本降 60%，但 benchmark 提升只有 3%。边际收益递减开始了。
items.take: Cost is the real moat now. When capability plateaus, whoever runs cheapest wins the API war.
items.take_zh: 成本才是真护城河。能力到顶之后，谁跑得最便宜谁赢 API 战争。

items.tldr: Korea Sept first-20-day exports +14% YoY, semiconductors half of it. The global trade canary is still singing.
items.tldr_zh: 韩国 9 月前 20 日出口同比 +14%，半导体占一半。全球贸易金丝雀还在唱歌。
items.take: Korea exports are the closest thing to a real-time GDP pulse for the world. When this canary stops, sell everything.
items.take_zh: 韩国出口是全球 GDP 最接近实时的脉搏。这只金丝雀停止唱歌的时候，卖掉一切。

items.tldr: Anthropic launches Claude Code plugin ecosystem. The shift from tool to platform — whoever owns the developers owns the future.
items.tldr_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Code plugin 生态系统。从工具到平台的转变 — 谁拥有开发者，谁拥有未来。
items.take: This is the Microsoft playbook: don't just make a good product, make it the thing other products are built on.
items.take_zh: 这是微软的剧本：不只是做一个好产品，而是让它成为别人产品的地基。
